description: AUTHORITATIVE brand → Google account → YouTube channel mapping. Single source of truth. No secrets stored here (no refresh_token, access_token, client_secret, auth code). Token lives in youtube_tokens.json per brand key.

rules.isolation: Per-brand token isolation: each brand's refresh_token only overwrites its own key in youtube_tokens.json. Never clobber another brand's entry.
rules.fresh_state: Fresh OAuth state per attempt: state generated via PKCE challenge per attempt, rejected if mismatched (stale-state rejection).
rules.pkce: PKCE S256 enabled (code_verifier 32 bytes, code_challenge SHA256).
rules.callback: Safe callback: handles /favicon.ico, error param, missing code, stale state with explicit 400 and user guidance.
rules.stale_rejection: State mismatch → 400 with 'Authorization attempt expired or is no longer active. Please use the current authorization URL.'
rules.invalid_grant: Token revocation detected via invalid_grant error; classify and surface as INVALID_GRANT requiring founder re-auth.
rules.invalid_scope: Scope errors classified as INVALID_SCOPE; check SCOPES configuration.
rules.wrong_channel: If token owns channels not containing expected_channel_id, REJECT and do NOT save (never overwrite valid token with bad auth).
rules.force_isolation: --force affects ONLY the single requested brand (or each brand iteratively when --all). Never global wipe.
rules.verify: --verify audits every brand (BRANDS list) and reports MISSING/INVALID_GRANT/INVALID_SCOPE/WRONG_CHANNEL.
rules.never_overwrite: Never overwrite a valid token with a bad authentication: wrong-channel and exchange failures return False before _save_tokens.
rules.fail_loud: Wrong-brand publishing blocked loudly via brand_identity_resolver and hard channel routing (CHANNEL_IDENTITY_MISMATCH).
